UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public studio profile for a registered SonicCrate user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in the studio header.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user acknowledged their account creation email link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's registered email address.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Registered email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public user profile metadata for SonicCrate.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) accessible strictly by the account owner.
